episodes.title: Superpoteri
episodes.summary: At an exclusive private high school, student athlete Chiara forges an unlikely bond with rebellious classmate Ludovica and mysterious new boy Damiano.

episodes.title: Burattino
episodes.summary: Chiara gets a peace offering from her dad. Camilla makes an offhand comment that impacts Chiara's love life. Ludo suffers a blow at a family event.

episodes.title: #Friendzone
episodes.summary: Chiara begs Camilla for a chance to explain things, Nico and Brando plot against Damiano, and Fiore offers Ludo a solution to her money troubles.

episodes.title: Emma
episodes.summary: Saverio introduces Ludo to an admirer who saw her at the club. Fabio helps Damiano out of a bind. A run-in at a party leads Chiara to act recklessly.

episodes.title: L'ultimo scatto
episodes.summary: Ludo gets infuriating news, Chiara and her parents start therapy, and Saverio invites the girls to a secret party, where a familiar face shows up.

episodes.title: #Love
episodes.summary: In the aftermath, Ludo, Damiano and Chiara try to cover their tracks and grapple with feelings of guilt and fear. Fabio savors a life-changing moment.

episodes.title: #justagame
episodes.summary: As a new school year begins, Chiara helps Ludo deal with a troublesome client, and Damiano takes on another job to pay down his debt to Fiore.

episodes.title: Rilancio
episodes.summary: Fiore surprises Chiara at school and takes her on a drive. Ludo locks horns with her new teacher. Damiano's late-night exploits leave him drained.

episodes.title: Fantasmi
episodes.summary: Nagging suspicions drive a wedge between Chiara and Damiano. Brando is forced to choose sides when Nico and the others attack Fabio at school.

episodes.title: Obbligo o verità
episodes.summary: While a shell-shocked Chiara braces for fallout from the incident at Marge, Brando scrambles to shore up his tough-guy image -- at school and at home.

episodes.title: Vicolo cieco
episodes.summary: Ludo's mother drops a bombshell, Damiano tries to make sense of Chiara's sudden change of heart, and Chiara meets Brando's family.

episodes.title: Baby
episodes.summary: As Brando's latest video sends shock waves through Collodi, Chiara plots her revenge, and Ludo seeks refuge from her stalker.

episodes.title: San Valentino
episodes.summary: When an acquaintance is caught in a police raid, Chiara and Ludo worry for their safety. A private investigator offers Damiano a deal.

episodes.title: 26 aprile 1915
episodes.summary: A story on a gossip site sends rumors flying at Collodi — and prompts Ludo to make big changes. Damiano sneaks a camera into Fiore's spare apartment.

episodes.title: Esprimi un desiderio
episodes.summary: On the eve of her 18th birthday, a defiant Ludo accepts a challenge from Virginia. Meanwhile, Chiara faces one unsettling surprise after another.

episodes.title: Niente più segreti
episodes.summary: As her new life begins to unravel, Ludo makes a desperate move. A TV interview puts Chiara in a difficult position. Damiano opens up to Aurora.

episodes.title: 100 giorni
episodes.summary: While Chiara deals with the fallout from her post, Ludo searches for an escape, Damiano seeks advice from Monica, and Brando confronts his father.

episodes.title: Oltre l'acquario
episodes.summary: As the case goes to trial, Chiara and Ludo weigh their options for the future and scour Rome for the one person who could help bring Fiore to justice.
